items.title: Project Cycle Management
items.description: Design, Procurement, Supervision, Appraisal, Monitoring and Evaluation across the full lifecycle of infrastructure projects.

items.title: Civil and Structural Engineering

items.description: Planning and delivery of urban infrastructure, including markets, transport terminals, drainage, and public facilities.

items.title: Training and Capacity Building

items.title: Road Safety, Traffic & Transportation Engineering

items.title: Management Consulting
items.description: Technical audit, procurement audits, contract management reviews, and organizational development advisory.
